refnamediv.refpurpose: Get and/or set the current session name

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
name
The session name references the name of the session, which is used in cookies and URLs (e.g. PHPSESSID). It should contain only alphanumeric characters; it should be short and descriptive (i.e. for users with enabled cookie warnings). If name is specified and not &null;, the name of the current session is changed to its value.
A name that is empty, numeric (such as 123 or 1e3), contains a NUL byte or contains any of the characters =,;.[, space, tab, carriage return, line feed, vertical tab or form feed is refused with an E_WARNING, and the current session name is left unchanged.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns the name of the current session. If name is given and function updates the session name, name of the old session is returned, &return.falseforfailure;. If name is refused, an E_WARNING is raised and the old session name is returned. &false; is returned, with an E_WARNING, when name is given and a session is active or the headers have already been sent.

&reftitle.changelog;
&Version; &Description;
8.4.4, 8.3.17
A name that is empty, numeric or contains a forbidden character is now refused by session_name itself; previously the failure only occurred when the session was started.
8.4.0
A ValueError is now thrown when name contains a NUL byte; previously an E_WARNING was raised.
8.0.0
name is nullable now.
7.2.0
session_name checks session status, previously it only checked cookie status. Therefore, older session_name allows to call session_name after session_start, which changes the name of the active session.
